svg.aria-label: Projects. Drones: Semi-Autonomous Drone: Waypoint navigation and planned missions, with the pilot able to take over at any point; Surveillance Drone: Compact airframe with a live video feed, built for GPS-denied and confined spaces; Long-Range FPV Drone: 5-inch long-range build with a payload release mechanism; Cinewhoop: Ducted FPV drone for smooth cinematic, close-proximity shots. Software & automation: Business Process Automation: Workflows that connect systems and take repetitive manual steps out of daily operations; CRM & Client Lifecycle: One system from first enquiry to delivery: lead pipeline, automated follow-ups, full client history. Embedded & IoT: Smart Home IoT System: Sensors and automation over Blynk and MQTT; GSM Accident Alert: Collision detection with emergency alerts; RFID Security & Attendance: Access control with live attendance tracking.
